SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.workspace_id,
    c.first_name,
    c.last_name,
    c.email,
    c.linkedin_url,
    c.phone,
    c.company_id,
    co.name AS company_name,
    li.occurred_at AS last_interaction_at,
    li.channel AS last_channel,
    li.note AS last_note,
    rt.id AS reconnect_task_id,
    rt.status AS reconnect_task_status,
    rt.due_at AS reconnect_due_at
   FROM crm_contacts c
     LEFT JOIN crm_companies co ON co.id = c.company_id
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.occurred_at,
            i.channel,
            i.note
           FROM crm_interactions i
          WHERE i.contact_id = c.id
          ORDER BY i.occurred_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) li ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT t.id,
            t.status,
            t.due_at
           FROM tasks t
          WHERE t.crm_contact_id = c.id AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['inbox'::task_status, 'next'::task_status, 'waiting'::task_status, 'scheduled'::task_status]))
          ORDER BY t.due_at, t.updated_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) rt ON true;
select null::uuid workspace_id,null::text name_norm,null::text display_name,null::timestamptz last_seen_at,null::bigint times_used where false;

SELECT c.id AS contact_id,
    c.workspace_id,
    li.last_next_action,
    COALESCE(ot.open_task_count, 0) AS open_task_count,
        CASE
            WHEN li.last_next_action = 'disconnect'::crm_next_action THEN 'disconnect'::text
            WHEN COALESCE(ot.open_task_count, 0) > 0 THEN 'open_task'::text
            ELSE 'no_task'::text
        END AS ui_status
   FROM crm_contacts c
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT i.next_action AS last_next_action
           FROM crm_interactions i
          WHERE i.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND i.contact_id = c.id
          ORDER BY i.occurred_at DESC NULLS LAST, i.created_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) li ON true
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT count(*)::integer AS open_task_count
           FROM tasks t
          WHERE t.workspace_id = c.workspace_id AND t.crm_contact_id = c.id AND (t.status = ANY (ARRAY['inbox'::task_status, 'next'::task_status, 'waiting'::task_status, 'scheduled'::task_status]))) ot ON true;
select null::uuid contact_id,null::uuid workspace_id,null::text first_name,null::text last_name,null::text email,null::text linkedin_url,null::text phone,null::json tags where false;

SELECT t.id,
    t.workspace_id,
    t.title,
    t.description,
    t.status,
    t.next_step,
    t.priority,
    t.time_estimate_min,
    t.due_at,
    t.category_id,
    t.created_by,
    t.assigned_to,
    t.waiting_for,
    t.energy_level,
    t.created_at,
    t.updated_at,
    t.crm_company_id,
    t.crm_contact_id,
    t.crm_interaction_id,
    c.first_name AS crm_first_name,
    c.last_name AS crm_last_name,
    c.email AS crm_email,
    c.linkedin_url AS crm_linkedin_url,
    c.phone AS crm_phone,
    co.id AS crm_company_id_resolved,
    co.name AS crm_company_name
   FROM tasks t
     LEFT JOIN crm_contacts c ON c.id = t.crm_contact_id AND c.workspace_id = t.workspace_id
     LEFT JOIN crm_companies co ON co.id = COALESCE(t.crm_company_id, c.company_id) AND co.workspace_id = t.workspace_id;
